mechanism_narrative: A high level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.5% triggers a monetary policy response that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (y/y), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that drives consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a strong housing market (HOUST > 1500) indicates resilient consumer demand that offsets the negative impact of higher interest rates, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) indicates a weakening consumer sector that reduces disposable income and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong economic activity that drives corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising HOUST and strong RSAFS fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
